W.note: Very tight collapsed pill with segmented progress and a clean timeline with tracking number, but no carrier name or next-action beyond Dismiss.

X.note: Richest and most polished tracker (progress stepper, scan log, copy/refresh/alerts, multi-package dots) though the collapsed subtitle truncates and the opened state is a bit denser.

Y.note: Compact with carrier badge, ETA window and action buttons, but the Carrier page button wraps awkwardly and the collapsed state omits ETA.

Z.note: Handsome collapsed row, but carrier tabs are confusing for one package, there is empty padding at the bottom, and it has less screen-reader support.
